config_entries.label: Name
config_entries.description: The name of the effect. Defaults to `Color Wipe`.

config_entries.label: Add LED Interval
config_entries.description: The interval with which to shift in new LEDs at the beginning of the strip. Defaults to `100ms`.

config_entries.label: Colors
config_entries.description: The colors to shift in at the beginning of the strip. Defaults to shifting in random colors.

config_entries.label: Num Leds
config_entries.description: The number of LEDs of this type to have before transitioning to the next color. If `gradient` is true, this will be the number of LEDs over which the color transition will occur.

config_entries.label: Blue
config_entries.description: The percentage the blue color channel should be on. Defaults to `100%`.

config_entries.label: Color
config_entries.description: A [standard CSS color name](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/named-color) or a hex value in the form `0xRRGGBB` to use instead of **red**, **green** and **blue**. Also sets **color_brightness**, as described in [light state](https://esphome.io/components/light/#light-state).

config_entries.label: Color Brightness
config_entries.description: A brightness to scale **red**, **green** and **blue** by. Defaults to `100%`.

config_entries.label: Gradient
config_entries.description: If `true` the current color will transition with a gradient over `num_leds` to the next color. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Green
config_entries.description: The percentage the green color channel should be on. Defaults to `100%`.

config_entries.label: Random
config_entries.description: If set to `true`, will overwrite the RGB colors by a new, randomly-chosen color each time. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Red
config_entries.description: The percentage the red color channel should be on. Defaults to `100%`.

config_entries.label: Reverse
config_entries.description: Whether to reverse the direction of the color wipe. Defaults to `false`.
